script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: "Chasing Stars"

INT. STUDIO - NIGHT

A bustling, open-plan studio, filled with artists, musicians, and writers, all working into the early hours.

(Our PROTAGONIST, LUCY, a determined young writer, sits at a table in the corner, typing furiously on her laptop. She's deeply focused on her work, her brow furrowed with concentration.)

LUCY
(Mumbling to herself)
I'll make it work. I'll get published. I'll be successful.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

(Weeks later. Lucy, disheveled and exhausted, sits at a table in a coffee shop. She's staring at an empty page on her laptop, her once-determined expression now filled with doubt and frustration.)

LUCY
(To herself)
What's the point? I've been writing for months, and nothing's happening.

(Suddenly, a hand lands on her shoulder. She jumps, startled.)

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

(A familiar face. It's RICHARD, a successful novelist she met at the studio. He offers her a sympathetic smile.)

RICHARD
Hey, Lucy. You look troubled.

LUCY
(Sighs)
I've hit a wall with my writing. I don't know if I can keep going.

RICHARD
(Kindly)
Every writer hits a wall at some point. It's part of the process.

INT. LUCY'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

(Lucy and Richard sit on her couch, surrounded by books. She tells him about her struggles, her doubts, her fears of failure. He listens, offering advice and encouragement.)

RICHARD
You have to believe in yourself, Lucy. Your ambition is what got you here. Don't let it slip away now.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

(Weeks later. Lucy is back at the studio, writing. She's made progress, but the road ahead still seems long and uncertain.)

LUCY
(Muttering to herself)
I can do this. I'll finish this book. I'll be successful.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

(Months later. Lucy and Richard sit in the same coffee shop, their laptops open in front of them. Lucy's book is now complete, and she's received an offer from a publisher.)

LUCY
(Excitedly)
I did it! I got published!

RICHARD
(Grinning)
I knew you could do it, Lucy.

INT. PUBLISHER'S OFFICE - DAY

(Lucy sits in a grand office, surrounded by publishers and agents. She's nervous, but proud. She's finally achieved her dream.)

LUCY
(To herself)
I made it. I'm a published author.

INT. STUDIO - NIGHT

(Years later. Lucy sits at her old table in the studio, looking at the younger writers around her. She sees the determination in their eyes, and she smiles.)

LUCY
(Whispering to herself)
Keep going. Believe in yourself. Your ambition is what will get you there.

FADE OUT.

---

End of screenplay.
